notes.title: Starstruck's 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/2ecfe0fde9334fadf40e663807e8b75a728c4a56.jpg[/img]
Happy 1 year anniversary, everyone!

Please help yourself to a Starstruck cookie fresh out of the oven.

Let's celebrate today with a few special announcements.

[h2]Biggest Discounts Ever[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/2f96e2e8082980968af6ab62bcbea0f53bffe961.jpg[/img]

Starstruck is now on sale for 50% off for the first time ever! If you or a friend haven't played it yet, this is the moment you've been waiting for. The soundtrack is also on sale too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/6c352c8a244fb207d3c4cfc6a1c0a32c86f6328a.jpg[/img]

The remaining limited supply of black T-shirts is also on sale for $12.50 plus shipping. This is a very good deal, but there's only one size left: Asian medium (it's a little bit smaller than an American medium).

T-shirts available here: https://shop.starstruckgame.com/

[h2]Steam Trading Cards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/0f699ad5e9add971ccf414329ad8f6c45e48dbe2.png[/img]
Steam trading cards are finally here! I took brand new photos of the clay figures just for these cards. If you've already played Starstruck, I think some cards will automatically get added to your Steam account but I'm not sure.

Rumors say there may also be Steam badges, profile wallpapers, and emotes available now too...

[h2]Revealing one of Starstruck's biggest secrets[/h2]

To celebrate today, I want to reveal a hidden feature in Starstruck that nobody ever discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/9e1be31a27f1a872084573086b146da3f6ba574c.png[/img]
See those stickers on and nearby the Captain's guitar in the above screenshot? That's the secret: you can decorate the Captain's stuff with your own stickers by just putting some PNG files in a special folder! Personalize the Captain's ship and guitar however feels right to you. Have you ever heard of a hidden feature like this in a game before?

Instructions here: https://starstruckgame.com/stickers.html

This feature has actually been in the game ever since it released, but nobody ever found it. (Actually, this isn't the only secret that nobody ever found.)

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

With this 50% discount, I hope some more people can have an interesting time playing the game. Looking back at Starstruck, I think it's not perfect but it has some unique value. It's one of the few things in my life I'm happy that I got to be part of making.

To be honest with you, lately I haven't been able to follow my creative dreams much anymore, due to various financial reasons plus the low level of interest in Starstruck. To make ends meet, I've found a new job working on programming advertising systems which has been taking up almost all of my time, even usually on nights and weekends. But even if I can't follow all of my artistic dreams right now, it still makes me happy whenever I see a new review appear on Starstruck's page.

Whether you've already played the game or you're going to play it for the first time now, thank you for giving something like this a chance. I hope you get something interesting out of it.

notes.title: February 2023 Update
notes.content:
Hello Stars Truckers! Hope your 2023 is going well. This is going to be a big year for Starstruck, so let's get right into the development status update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/ef9aa16f8e6ab35a38497eaa987c210c565b4d83.png[/img]
[i]A preview of the art sent on the newsletter! If you missed it, you can still get it (and four other exclusive four-panel comics) emailed to you instantly when you [url=https://starstruckgame.com/newsletter.html]join the newsletter[/url][/i].

[b]Development Status Update[/b]

At the time of the last update, I was polishing everything in the game up until the ending. So now five months later, where are things?

Well, I'm happy to say the game is now about [b]95% polished for everything up until the ending[/b]! In addition, [b]I've started working on the ending[/b], which I'll be fully diving into working on next week. This is a big step forward and I can hardly believe it myself.

Here's some of what's been achieved recently (that I can show you without spoiling things):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/c33d8b55880d7d2cc90d45cda95e498b28067b25.png[/img]

[b]Improved rhythm UI[/b]! Not only does it look better, but the stem on each note is now centered so timing is easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/d3af6884acfde9910b5a61eebfd9abd3c5c84887.png[/img]

[b]Upgraded text/font system[/b]! This not only makes text across all languages appear crisper, but also enables Chinese language support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/4f2cdd82d332e46a7705dab717f543d5053d8315.gif[/img]

[b]Improved physics[/b]! Buildings explode better, characters can be thrown around, and the physics is "wackier" in general.

There's many more things I implemented as well, such as Steam Deck compatibility and adding some new complex events to the story. Overall, I'd say the game is on its way to becoming more of a finished product.

Thanks for reading and keeping up with my game. I'm working really hard on it every day. I think it's going to be a special game. See you in the next update, where hopefully I'll be able to give more big news about the game getting closer to completion!

-Max

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054950/Starstruck_Hands_of_Time/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/8c9e76ddf7c96c37a6efd1fc6aaf75fb010a57a1.png[/img]

PS: As a side project, I helped in the English localization of a previously Chinese-only RPG Maker game called "Have a Nice Dream". It went somewhat viral in China in 2021, and now it's available in English! Oh yeah, and it's free!

If you're into short and thought-provoking RPG Maker games, you can get the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625080/_/

notes.title: August 2022 Update
notes.content:
Hello Stars Truckers! Recently, a few people have asked me about the status of the game. Then I realized... even though I write updates every few months on the [url=https://starstruckgame.com/newsletter.html]game's newsletter[/url], I haven't posted an update on Steam on a while! So here's today's newsletter update, re-posted here on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/b08419cee5594d46a1c2649b12b04ee46ad04871.jpg[/img]
[i]A preview of the exclusive 4-panel comic sent on the newsletter! If you missed it, you can still get it (and the three other comics) emailed to you instantly when you [url=https://starstruckgame.com/newsletter.html]join the newsletter[/url][/i].

[b]Development Status Update[/b]

In the last email, I mentioned that I had the game playable in a barebones way up until the ending. So four months later, how has development been going?

It's been going well! The game is now [b]about 70% polished[/b] for everything up until the ending!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/16b0a150b5cf4bc31820249afff41a10052b4b55.png[/img]

I keep saying I "polished" the game, but what does that mean? Here's one example: the buildings in town now look different after you destroy them as the Captain. It would be a shame if the final game didn't work like this, right? Along with stuff like this and improving/expanding many of the cutscenes, I've also been adding new content and a whole bunch of secrets where it felt right. A first draft of the main dialogue is now in the game, too.

Next development update should be an exciting one, since (hopefully) I'll be able to say things are polished to satisfaction and that I've started working on the ending.

Thanks for reading. See you in the next email update in a few months!

-Max

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054950/Starstruck_Hands_of_Time/

notes.title: 🎃Big Spooky Halloween Demo Update
notes.content:
[h3]Download the demo for free on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054950/Starstruck_Hands_of_Time/#game_area_purchase]here[/url][/h3]

Hi everyone! Happy early Halloween!

I'm updating Starstuck's demo today with a bunch of new stuff:

[h2]1. A Spooky New Song[/h2]

A new Free Play song by [url=https://twitter.com/bleepmusic]bleep[/url] titled "Open 24 Hours" about a dead mall, with art by [url=https://twitter.com/juneflowa]June Flower[/url].

There are 5 bonus songs in total now! This is a pretty generous free demo, don't you think?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/bfc990a737804c97ce05be296b4b8891731670bc.png[/img]

[h2]2. Rhythm Control Remapping Support[/h2]

Rhythm control remapping is finally here! You can now use whatever buttons or keys you want during the songs.

Use a different control scheme on your keyboard or gamepad, or even setup a Wii or PS2 guitar controller!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/0ebb51f20dd1f6cdce504aff687654ef4a949cbf.png[/img]

I've tested it with all kinds of controllers, as you can see in the photo below. If you need help setting something up, check out the newly expanded [url=https://playstarstruck.com/faq.html]FAQ[/url] or ask your question in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1297720/discussions/]forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/starstruck]Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/a1dd3ed4cc0951509e932a41cf91e6850b741400.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Performance Improvements[/h2]

I've made a ton of optimizations, so if the game didn't run well for you before, maybe it will now!

Before, I had to run it on my laptop at 720p, but now it runs at 60 fps at 1080p on the highest settings:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/a20c4afeb5c3813d43c4e74c88b498640bc3816b.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Visual Improvements[/h2]

Lots of assets and scenes have been improved! Here's one example:

New version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/ee7324d6d22f4188d92095735a9104363d40f304.png[/img]

Old version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/584b14dfe7c4efe8941a8de2387ce9335861e1d2.png[/img]

[h2]5. Lots of other small improvements[/h2]

A lot of other small changes too. Here's everything else from the changelog:

[list]
[*]Improved the visuals for notes during rhythm gameplay
[*]Added option to change the size of the lyrics subtitles
[*]Improved character movement so it appears less jittery
[*]Increased the hand's movement speed while holding tools
[*]Corrected the icon used for DualShock controllers during rhythm gameplay to display "R1" instead of "RT"
[*]Added the hit window configuration option to the rhythm options menu
[*]Added a "no symbol" on scenario icons in Neighborhood.exe that aren't available in the demo
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent loading of save files created by previous versions of the game
[*]Minor bugfixes and improvements
[/list]

[h2]Hope you like the update[/h2]

Thanks for following my game. I'm working on the full game every day and making continuous progress, so I'm looking forward to the day when we can enjoy the full version of the game together!

notes.title: Starstruck @ PAX Online 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/9fbb6fd651434a7abe1371ec12617a51483b78ca.png[/img]

Hello! Starstruck is participating in PAX Online 2020, which starts today! In fact, Starstruck was even selected as a PAX Rising game this year!

To celebrate that, I'm releasing a huge update to Starstruck's prologue demo. You can play it either by downloading the demo on this Steam page or downloading the standalone demo, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297720/Starstruck_Prologue/]Starstruck: Prologue[/url].

Here's what's in the update:

[h2]Russian Language Support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/1dc6914420a4df4e9d76e868da7570d108e77d17.png[/img]

The demo is now completely playable in Russian! All of the text in the game is translated, including lyrics subtitles and images, so please give it a try if you're a Russian speaker. A lot of work went into this, so I hope you like it.

[h2]Free Play Mode (with two new songs)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37569473/511d125c10c2727abb9673adb2b06a146ddc3edd.gif[/img]

This update also introduces Free Play mode, a new feature which lets you instantly replay any song from the game. To access Free Play mode, clear the main story of the Prologue and then click on the Data icon on the ship's computer.

Within Free Play mode are also two new songs! These songs are pretty challenging on Master Mode, and I think playing them is pretty fun. Feel free to share your high scores.

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]

Here's a list of the other changes in this patch:
[list]
[*] Made it possible to pause and restart or quit in the middle of songs
[*] Added run button support in the town area
[*] Changed the color to be purple for notes that represent the RT button on the Xbox 360 and Xbox One controllers
[*] Made Dawn's brother animate during Inside These Walls
[*] Improved the visuals of the town area
[*] Various minor bugfixes
[*] Various minor text improvements
[/list]

[h2]Wishlist Now[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054950

notes.title: Difficulty Modes! (Dev Update)
notes.content:
Today I'm announcing a new feature: [b]difficulty modes[/b]! I want to explain exactly how everything works, so I'm posting this announcement on Steam rather than [url=https://twitter.com/playstarstruck]Twitter[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/ad89748d119e48c4d12832cd05fa8a68e3223b15.png[/img]

There are two difficulty modes to choose from. [b]Normal Mode[/b] is great for people who want to enjoy the story, but if you're looking for an extra challenge, try [b]Master Mode[/b]. Of course, you can swap between them at any time.

[table][tr][th][b]Master Mode[/b][/th][th][b]Normal Mode[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/9d653ee17018654b049ae8f1ddf9b22a9cf9be7a.gif[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/e8506d094e3b7209b613edeae9148569f5cbba2d.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
In Master Mode, everything moves faster, and the charts contain more notes to press. And if you're playing with a controller, the control scheme also changes slightly to add some more depth:

[table][tr][th][b]Master Mode Controls[/b][/th][th][b]Normal Mode Controls[/b][/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/91c27b991979a3af14b66220f6d53d0f1c040f0b.gif[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753114/5b5fc63494efedfe934f6bf4dcbd8eec5c068641.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Let's say you're playing with an Xbox 360  controller. In Master Mode, the buttons you need to press would be RT, Y, B, and A. But in Normal Mode, the buttons would be Y, B, A, and X. (The control stick is also used in both modes to move to the upper or lower areas of notes on the screen.)

Why does Master Mode use Right Trigger instead of X? Well, think about all the multi-button combinations that are uniquely possible with RT: RT+Y, RT+B, and RT+Y+B. This adds a significant challenge, trust me! To be honest, even I actually have trouble getting an "A" rank on the later songs in the game.
